description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'ProjectSearchFilterParams' that extends a base 'FilterParams' class. It encapsulates various filtering and sorting parameters for searching projects within the OrangeHRM Time module, including project IDs, customer ID, employee number, names, and exclusion list. The class provides getters and setters for each property and initializes the default sort field to 'project.name'.

classes.name: ProjectSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating project search filter parameters, including project IDs, customer ID, employee number, names, and exclusion filters. It extends the base FilterParams class and sets a default sort field.

methods.name: getProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the list of project IDs to filter by.

methods.name: setProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the list of project IDs to filter by.

methods.name: getCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Returns the customer or project name filter.

methods.name: setCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Sets the customer or project name filter.

methods.name: getExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the list of project IDs to exclude.

methods.name: setExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the list of project IDs to exclude.
